name: choruz-record-demo
title_zh: 录屏前先跑通一遍，再让镜头跟着真实 Agent 走
tagline_zh: 演示视频最容易翻车的地方不是剪辑，是录到一半发现本地 Agent 根本没连上远端。它逼你先跑通一遍真实交互。
tagline_en: Demo videos rarely fail in editing — they fail when the local Agent never actually reached the remote one. This.
desc_en: Record and verify a truthful Choruz product demo or browser workflow video, including real local and remote Agent interactions. Use for requested recordings, not as an automatic media requirement for every GUI pull request.
why_zh: 它把「先验证、后录制」写成流程：本地与远端 Agent 的真实往返必须先在镜头外跑通，录到的才算数。
why_en: It bakes verify-then-record into the flow: the local-to-remote Agent round trip must pass off-camera before anything counts as.
limit_zh: 只在被明确要求录屏时触发，不会自动给每个 GUI PR 配视频。
limit_en: Only runs when a recording is explicitly requested — it won't auto-attach video to every GUI PR. Requires a working local-to-remote Choruz Agent.
title_en: Record a truthful Choruz demo with real Agent runs
